enabled.title: Send pseudonymous usage data
enabled.description: Allow Cisco to collect pseudonymous usage data about Splunk Observability Studio itself. This setting does not change what Splunk Observability Studio collects from your agents or shows you locally.

o11yOAuth.title: O11y OAuth sign-in
o11yOAuth.description: Saved values for signing in to Splunk Observability Cloud with O11y OAuth.

realm.title: Realm
realm.description: The Splunk Observability Cloud realm to sign in to, for example us0. Leave empty to enter it at sign-in.

orgId.title: Organization ID
orgId.description: The Splunk Observability Cloud organization ID to sign in to. Leave empty to enter it at sign-in.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: The client ID of the O11y OAuth client an organization admin registered. Leave empty to enter it at sign-in.

clientSecret.title: Client secret
clientSecret.description: The client secret of the O11y OAuth client, stored in plain text in this file. Leave empty to enter it at sign-in.
